abstract: A retrospective review was done on all high volume choriocarcinomas and other germ cell tumors of men with serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG) levels greater than 50,000 mIU/ml to determine the incidence and characteristics of hyperthyroidism in this setting. Nineteen patients were identified with high beta-HCG levels, but because 2 did not have thyroid function tests performed, the cases of only 17 patients were evaluable. Of these, 14 (82%) had primary testicular carcinoma and 3 (18%) had extragonadal tumors. Beta-HCG levels on presentation ranged from 80,000 to 3,058,000 mIU/ml, with a median of 243,500 mIU/ml. Seven of the 17 evaluable cases (41%) had T4 serum levels higher than 12 micrograms/dl (normal level 4 to 12 micrograms/dl) with a median value of 15.4 micrograms/dl (range, 12.6 to 33.5 micrograms/dl); serum T4 levels correlated with beta-HCG levels (r = 0.84). All seven patients with elevated T4 levels had beta-HCG values greater than 200,000 mIU/ml, and three of these seven had clinical manifestations that could be attributed to an elevated serum T4; only one patient required specific antithyroid treatment; and after control of primary disease, all other patients had normalization of thyroid function. The most common manifestations of hyperthyroidism in our series were tachycardia, hypertension, and a systolic flow murmur; none of the patients had thyroid gland enlargement. We conclude that subclinical hyperthyroidism is a relatively common phenomenon in germ cell tumors of men with high levels of beta-HCG and that control of the primary disease results in serum T4 level normalization.
abstract_ja: 血清β-hCG値が50,000 mIU/mlを超える男性の高容量絨毛癌およびその他の胚細胞腫瘍について後方視的レビューを行い、この状況における甲状腺機能亢進症の頻度と特徴を調べました。β-hCG値が高値を示した患者は19例が同定されましたが、甲状腺機能検査が未実施の2例を除き、評価可能な症例は17例でした。このうち14例(82%)は原発性精巣がん、3例(18%)は性腺外腫瘍でした。初診時のβ-hCG値は80,000〜3,058,000 mIU/mlで、中央値は243,500 mIU/mlでした。評価可能な17例中7例(41%)でT4血清値が12 μg/dlを超え(正常値4〜12 μg/dl)、中央値は15.4 μg/dl(範囲12.6〜33.5 μg/dl)でした。血清T4値はβ-hCG値と相関していました(r=0.84)。T4値が上昇した7例すべてでβ-hCG値は200,000 mIU/mlを超えていました。このうち3例では血清T4上昇に起因すると考えられる臨床症状がみられ、抗甲状腺薬による特異的治療が必要だったのは1例のみでした。原発巣の制御後、その他の全患者で甲状腺機能が正常化しました。本シリーズで最も多い甲状腺機能亢進症の症状は頻脈、高血圧、収縮期の血流性雑音で、甲状腺腫の腫大は1例もみられませんでした。高β-hCG値を示す男性の胚細胞腫瘍では潜在性甲状腺機能亢進症が比較的よくみられ、原発巣の制御により血清T4値が正常化すると結論づけます。
